title: Roast Brussels Sprouts with Balsamic and Honey
description: Brussels sprouts roasted until caramelised, then tossed with balsamic vinegar and honey.
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan (425°F), Gas Mark 7.
Spread the Brussels sprouts on a large baking tray and spray with oil. Season with salt and pepper.
Remove from the oven, drizzle over the balsamic vinegar and honey, toss to coat.
Return to the oven for a further 10 minutes until caramelised and tender.
notes: A brilliant side dish for roast dinners or alongside the Jumbled Cottage Pie (p.40). Add a sprinkle of chopped walnuts for extra crunch.
